oracle.expected: An independent verification establishes candidate-external trust from the bound validator capability and complete dependency closure rather than another verification's conclusion.
forbidden: Trust inferred solely from another verification
oracle.observable: The validator evaluation result exposes an independently verified candidate-external trust binding.

acceptance.when: The validator evaluation selector evaluates the candidate and its bound validator capability.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Supply candidate-controlled or incomplete trust bindings and observe the independent trust check reject them.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Independently evaluate candidate-external validator trust against bound source, content, dependency, compatibility, policy, and scope identities.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Untrusted or candidate-controlled bindings fail closed and do not become trust authority.

slice_hint.state_transition: Candidate trust unverified -> independently verified candidate-external trust or rejected evaluation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The evaluation independently binds candidate-external trust and rejects omitted, inherited-only, candidate-controlled, or incomplete trust verification.

forbidden: Validator source verification is inferred solely from another verification.

slice_hint.state_transition: Validator source not independently verified -> validator source independently verified.

acceptance.given: Validator source, content, semantic-dependency closure, compatibility, support policy, and candidate-external trust require independent FR-3 verification, and validator-content verification is not satisfied by the other categories.

oracle.expected: A dedicated real test evaluates validator content and produces a distinct validator-content verification result.
forbidden: Treating validator-content verification as satisfied by another verification category
Using CLI help, a schema, a capability descriptor, or an old receipt instead of a real validator-content test
oracle.observable: The executed dedicated pytest result separately asserts validator-content verification.

acceptance.then: Validator content has an independent verification result and cannot inherit satisfaction from another FR-3 category.
acceptance.when: Quick Dev authors and executes the dedicated FR-3 validator-content selector.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The dedicated validator-content selector fails when validator content is omitted, conflated with another FR-3 category, or verified through a non-behavior artifact.
